name: Variational Autoencoder-based Compression
definition: Autoencoders learn compressed latent codes by training encoder-decoder pairs to reconstruct their input. VAEs impose a probabilistic latent structure enabling sampling and interpolation.
summary: Variational Autoencoder-based Compression maps volumetric data to a probabilistic latent space for lossy compression, distinguishing itself from deterministic autoencoders by enabling sampling and interpolation.
